F*CK! It’s hard... I hate this game, but at the same time I have like 2200+ hours in it... I don’t even know how to explain my relationship with it, hahaha! I bought this game in 2015 and played it on my potato PC at barely 20 FPS, but had so much fun! I remember the days of random blueprints from barrels and so much more! I’m impressed and in love with the fact that the devs are still working hard on this game and pushing monthly updates! It’s such a different game after all these years! The graphics are lovely, the mechanics are fcking amazing, and there’s so much more than I can write here! Plus all the new gameplay the devs keep adding!

But f*ck, guys! This game has such a toxic community! It’s hard to enjoy it the same way on official servers... I can’t invite my newbie friends who barely have 10 hours, because the servers are full of 5k+ hour sweats! They want to enjoy the game, not have some mad player camping outside their base for 5 hours!! Even I stopped enjoying it the way I did years ago. When I want to “feel the game again” or see what the devs added in updates, I just go on PvE servers... I loved PvP, but not as toxic and angry as it is nowadays!

But if you’re new and just want to play4fun, buy it and play on PvE servers! There’s still sooo much to discover, including some pretty hard NPC fights and more! I mean... I’M IMPRESSED by how much the devs have done with this game over all these years! So for that, and for this beautiful and amazing game (minus the toxic community), I’d give it 10/10!
